messages:
Ava: Proposal: run a 30-person Design Partner pilot that recruits by mindset instead of company size — segments: product-builders, infra/ops, and cost-optimizers. Goal: surface divergent success criteria and requests.
Diego: Love it. I'll draft a 3-question screener that tags mindset signals (keeps it <30s). Target 10 per segment.
Maya: For incentives let's A/B two offers: 4 hours of priority support vs $500 credit. Track which yields more completed feedback sessions.
Jordan: Ops cohort needs a short infra runbook + optional 1:1 bootcamp. Product cohort gets prompt templates + example evals. Cost cohort gets an Optimize walkthrough.
Priya: Legal note: need a consent checkbox covering anonymized logs and incentive terms. I'll prepare a 1-line clause and checkbox text.
Ava: Quick success criteria draft:
- Product: 80% complete first integration + at least one feedback session within 14 days.
- Ops: perf baseline uploaded and infra notes submitted by >=30% of cohort.
- Cost: >=50% adopt at least one Optimize suggestion with measurable token-cost delta.
Diego: Measurement plan: funnel events (invite_sent, accept_ts, onboarding_complete_ts), feedback_sessions_count, nps_30, qualitative tags (blocker, feature_ask). I'll attach a tiny CSV schema in the doc.
Maya: Recruitment copy test: "Ship features faster" (impact) vs "Reduce inference costs" (efficiency). A/B subject lines and track open->accept->onboard.
Jordan: Onboarding checklist (to automate):
1) issue API key + sample call
2) perf test (10 requests) auto-upload results
3) join cohort Slack channel
4) schedule feedback session
Can we automate step 2 and push a small CSV to the analytics bucket?
Sam: Ops capacity: we can do 30 total but recommend staggering starts across three weekly waves of 10 to smooth 1:1s.
Priya: Confirmed anonymized telemetry ok with consent. I'll post the blurb and flag any accounting questions on credits.
Ava: Next steps: Diego = screener + measurement tags; Maya = two invite copy variants; Priya = consent snippet; Jordan = perf-test automation; Sam = cohort windows. I'll assemble rollout calendar and success criteria doc.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: add cohort to dp-beta-queue and auto-tag participants with segment label after screener pass. :robot_face:
Maya: One more ask  expose the psychographic segment as a filter in the evaluation dashboard so PMs can slice feedback by mindset.
Diego: I'll include sample report fields: participant_id, segment, accept_ts, onboarding_complete_ts, perf_avg_latency_ms, tokens_per_call, feedback_sessions_count, nps_30. Tiny JSON example will be in doc.
Ava: If no objections I'll start outreach next Tuesday and open wave 1 then. :thumbsup:
